# Frameworks

The external frameworks this fixture's policies refer to, and what each one obliges the organisation to.

One clause table reaches `Unplaced`. Nothing reaches the two headings under a standing, and
`framework-uncited` reports each of them.

### Unplaced

A framework heading written above the first standing, so it sits under none. The page offers the anchor
and says nothing about what citing it commits anyone to, which is what `framework-posture` reports.

## Obliged

### ISO 27001

Filed under a standing that binds. A clause citing it would roll up into `aligns-with`.

## Inspiration

### Azure Well-Architected Framework

Filed under a standing that binds nothing. A clause could cite it for provenance, and the roll-up would
leave it behind.
